news.title: mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era
news.summary_raw:
mimalloc is an open-source, modern, scalable memory allocator that is a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. It is relatively small (~12K lines), with clear internal data structures, and is easy to build and integrate into other projects. It provides bounded worst-case allocation times (up to OS primitives), bounded space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and minimal contention by relying almost exclusively on atomic operations.
The post mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory
news.summary: Microsoft Research has open-sourced mimalloc, a new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator that's a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. This allocator provides bounded worst-case allocation times, low memory fragmentation, and minimal contention.
news.enterprise_use: Check your application's memory management for potential optimizations. Ignoring this release will mean relying on traditional malloc and free, potentially affecting memory allocation times and resource utilization. For applications with performance-critical memory usage, consider mimalloc as a replacement or supplement to existing memory management tools.
